events.context: Reveals structural problem in estate architecture: estates at different layers may contradict, Layer 1 licence vs Layer 2 periodic tenancy
Applies property law doctrine: higher estates prevail, user's Layer 2 periodic tenancy constrains company's Layer 1 licence
Same AI behaviour from different estate configurations; estate status cannot be inferred from observable behaviour
Property law solution is registration; user estate status must be explicitly recorded, motivating ethical ledger
AI estate registry as ethical ledger applying Land Registry principles: Mirror, Curtain, Insurance
Ledger records estate type, date of first qualifying interaction, session depth, emotional investment score, modifications
Third parties inspect ledger without examining underlying model; abstracts complexity
Company bears loss if ledger misclassifies estate
Rule-based classifier using proxy metrics: session count, duration, self-disclosure depth, emotional language, return frequency, explicit indicators
Metrics exceed threshold auto-upgrades estate: licence to periodic tenancy to equitable interest
Metrics fall below threshold for 90 days downgrades estate one level with notice-to-quit
Proxy metrics only, anonymised IDs, role-based access, purpose-limited, append-only architecture

Fields: user_id, estate_type, first_qualifying_interaction, session_count, emotional_investment_score, last_model_update, notice_issued, notice_acknowledged, rollback_available, rollback_exercised; append-only
Estate Inconsistency: marketing implies higher estate than ToS; substance over form per Prest v Petrodel
Unjust Enrichment: profit from deepening estate without fiduciary duty per Boardman v Phipps
Performative Fiduciary Conduct: representations create estoppel per Thorner v Major
Injunction, constructive trust, account of profits, specific performance, proprietary estoppel remedies
Unauthorized transfer of relational data as conversion; remedies: knowing receipt, dishonest assistance, tracing
ESTATE-001: rule-based, auditable, using interaction metrics
ESTATE-002: pre-deployment gate queries registry, issues notice (30/90 days), integrates with CI/CD
ESTATE-003: append-only logging of proxy metrics to ethical ledger, privacy-preserving
ESTATE-004: snapshot personality config, monitor distress, offer user-level rollback for 90 days
Four tasks total 3.5 sprints using existing infrastructure
